set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set firewall policer class1-policer.explanation: The command `set firewall policer [parameter1]` configures a traffic policing policy in Junos, defining bandwidth limits and actions for exceeding them.

if-exceeding bandwidth-limit 5000000.explanation: The command `if-exceeding bandwidth-limit [parameter2]` sets a condition to trigger an action when traffic exceeds the specified bandwidth limit (`[parameter2]`).

if-exceeding burst-size-limit 62500.explanation: The command `if-exceeding burst-size-limit [parameter2]` sets the maximum burst size allowed for traffic exceeding a specified rate, enforcing traffic policing limits.

parameters.name: burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: Sudden size limit value, unit bytes.

if-exceeding peak-information-rate 60000.explanation: The command sets a traffic policing limit where traffic exceeding the specified peak-information-rate (PIR) is either dropped or marked for further action.

if-exceeding peak-burst-size-limit 62500.explanation: The command sets the maximum burst size limit for traffic exceeding a specified rate, where `[parameter2]` defines the burst size in bytes.

parameters.name: peak-burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: Peak sudden size limit, unit bytes.

set firewall policer class2-policer.explanation: The command `set firewall policer [parameter1]` creates or configures a policer named `[parameter1]` to control traffic bandwidth and burst limits in Junos.

if-exceeding bandwidth-limit 2000000.explanation: The command sets a bandwidth limit threshold for a traffic class, triggering actions when traffic exceeds the specified `[parameter2]` value in bits per second.

if-exceeding burst-size-limit 62500.explanation: The command `if-exceeding burst-size-limit [parameter2]` sets the maximum burst size allowed for traffic exceeding a specified rate, enforcing traffic policing limits.

parameters.name: burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: Sudden size limit value, unit bytes.

if-exceeding peak-burst-size-limit 12500.explanation: Sets the maximum burst size limit for traffic exceeding the peak rate, where `[parameter2]` specifies the burst size in bytes.

parameters.name: peak-burst-size-limit
parameters.explanation: Peak sudden size limit, unit bytes.

then color-over green forward.explanation: The command `then color-over [parameter2] [parameter3]` sets a specific forwarding class and packet loss priority (PLP) for traffic in Junos.

parameters.name: color
parameters.explanation: Colour tags such as green, yellow, red.

then color-over yellow forward.explanation: The command `then color-over [parameter2] [parameter3]` in Junos assigns a specific forwarding class (parameter2) and packet loss priority (parameter3) to traffic.

parameters.name: color
parameters.explanation: Colour tags such as green, yellow, red.

then color-over red discard.explanation: The command `then color-over [parameter2] [parameter3]` assigns a specific color (parameter2) and priority (parameter3) to traffic for differentiated services (DiffServ) handling.

parameters.name: color
parameters.explanation: Colour tags such as green, yellow, red.
